findings.evidence: Row claims version_status "published" with version "opt1-102", but per c2 "published" requires the maintainer to publish a release identifier that the version copies. SOURCE 1 (protocol text incl. changelog and leaderboard sections) and SOURCE 2 (leaderboard.json, whose metadata carries only "last_updated":"2026-09-27" and "total_tasks":102) contain no release identifier and nowhere the string "opt1-102" or any equivalent release tag. Changelog dates and last_updated are timestamps, not release identifiers. Per c2, a page publishing no release identifier supports "snapshot", and "snapshot" is a mismatch only when the page does publish one; here the row's "published" is the value contradicted by the protocol.
findings.repair: Set version_status to "snapshot" and version to the dated identity for this capture (e.g., "snapshot-2026-11-01"), or supply evidence that the maintainer publishes the release identifier "opt1-102" for this board.
